ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the food web diagram, which organism consumes shrimps as food?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram. In the lower right there is a picture of a shrimp, labeled next to it as “Shrimp-Secondary consumers/Omnivore”. Above and to the right of the shrimp there is a blue human-shaped icon, labeled as “Humans-Tertiary consumer/Omnivore”. From the shrimp's position there is an arrow connected and pointing to the human icon. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows point to the organism that consumes that food. The question asks which organism feeds on shrimp; the arrow points from shrimp to “Humans”, therefore the ones that eat shrimp are humans.
